name: @kiwa-lab/core
description: Core spec language + test environment abstractions for kiwa adapters (dapp / api / ui / data / cli). Renamed from @kiwa-lab/spec in v1.0.

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/**/*.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/src/types.js'
